usedFor: Freshdesk is where support requests land and HubSpot is where sales tracks accounts. A “New Ticket” in Freshdesk can run “Create Deal”, so a support conversation that hints at a sale does not stay buried.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Freshdesk, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A ticket carries a real customer and a real request, which is a better starting point for a deal than a bare contact record.

watchOut: “New Ticket” and “New Contact” are polling, so they run on a schedule. Every ticket would open a deal, so most teams filter it. “Update Deal” needs a deal ID.
